rationale: Placed in Telemetry/ because UBRSpotterSubsystem structurally mirrors UBRTelemetrySubsystem (host-authoritative WorldSubsystem, bind-at-OnWorldBeginPlay, Config-driven knobs) and directly consumes it — coach lines are resolved by rejoining GameState's live PlayerArray against Telemetry's finalized record via the already-public GetPlayerKey, with no new lookup API invented. Fully implemented and compilable: canned-line weighted/cooldown selection from DT_SpotterLines, the ≤12-calls and 3s-timeout config surface, and delegate dispatch to a UI-facing OnSpotterLineReady signal (the shipped default is canned-only, bEnableModelSpotter=false, matching cut-order item 4's 'config flip'). Deliberately left as TODOs rather than invented: the actual model/HTTP client (none exists anywhere in this codebase) and notable-event classification (spree streaks, rocket multi-kills) which needs a medal-evaluator system that isn't built in C++ yet — HandleKillFeedEntryAdded is wired up as the documented landing point for that system to call RequestEventLine once it exists.
